page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9a.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines that require significant memory capacity without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
